caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical object, possibly a container or vessel, with decorative elements. The object is shown in grayscale, with shading used to indicate depth and form. At the top of the cylinder is a sculpted lion figure lying on its stomach with its head turned to the side and its mouth slightly open; its mane and body are detailed with fine lines. Around the rim below the lion is a border made up of a series of rounded, bead-like shapes. The main body of the cylinder appears translucent or reflective, indicated by light shading and white highlights. The base of the cylinder also features a border of rounded shapes similar to the top rim. On the side of the base, there are two more sculpted lions in a reclining pose, with their heads turned outward and their manes detailed. These lions are positioned on either side of a pair of small, palm tree-like designs. The background of the drawing is left blank, and there is a faint rectangular border enclosing the composition. The artist's signature appears in the lower right corner.
title: Small Jar
